name: carclever-buying-assistant
description: Search U.S. vehicle listings, check a VIN, compare cars, and get Edmunds links to contact dealers.

interface.longDescription:
Find your next car with a buying assistant that helps you search, check and compare real U.S. vehicle listings.

CarClever searches a daily refreshed Edmunds vehicle catalogue to build a shortlist around your needs and budget. Search by location, make, model, year, trim, price, mileage, colour, drivetrain (where the VIN decode confirms it) and electrification, or describe practical needs such as a family SUV, commuter car or electric truck. Prioritize the lowest price, newest model year or lowest mileage. Ask for best value to rank cars by their price against similar local listings (a ZIP code is needed). Ask for more of the same search, up to 16 cars in total.
Already found a car? Check its VIN for vehicle identity, available listing details and NHTSA recall information. See model-year safety ratings and equipment information where available, with clear distinctions between confirmed details and items to verify with the dealer. Before you contact a dealer, you also get what is still unknown and the questions worth asking.
Compare two to four vehicles side by side on price, mileage, age, trim, powertrain, location and available NHTSA information. Newly observed listings and recorded asking-price drops help you spot options worth another look.

Each listed vehicle includes an Edmunds link. Open the listing and contact the dealer to confirm availability, the out-the-door price, equipment and your next step. If an exact listing is unavailable, CarClever can provide a search for similar vehicles.
Vehicle listings come from Edmunds through its Impact affiliate catalogue; vehicle decoding and recall information come from NHTSA.
Vehicle links open on Edmunds through affiliate links. CarClever may earn a commission from qualifying enquiries. Results are not ranked by commission.
defaultPrompt: Find a used Honda CR-V under $30,000 within 50 miles of 90210.
Find an electric truck under $80,000 near 90210.

positive.description: Search by budget and location. Current inventory varies; report no matches honestly.
positive.prompt: Find a used Honda CR-V under $30,000 within 50 miles of 90210.
positive.expected_behavior: Use Honda CR-V, used, priceMax 30000, ZIP 90210 and radius 50. Show matching returned vehicles without silently widening constraints.

positive.description: Test a practical need and electric powertrain.
positive.prompt: Find an electric pickup truck under $80,000 within 100 miles of 90210.
positive.expected_behavior: Search electric pickup trucks within the stated budget and radius. Clearly explain no matches or unknown attributes.

positive.description: Check a specific vehicle; listing presence may change.
positive.expected_behavior: Check the exact VIN, return available identity and listing details, and explain model-year recall scope without claiming VIN-specific applicability or repair status.

positive.description: Multi-step comparison uses VINs from the same search; compare two if only two match.
positive.prompt: Find used Honda CR-Vs under $30,000 within 50 miles of 90210, then compare the first three.
positive.expected_behavior: Search then compare two or three returned VINs using supported listing and NHTSA fields. If fewer than two match, explain and ask before broadening.

positive.description: Multi-step viewing-link resolution for a returned listing.
positive.prompt: Find a used Honda CR-V under $30,000 near 90210 and give me the Edmunds viewing link for the first car.
positive.expected_behavior: Search then resolve the first returned vehicle using its VIN/make/model/year. Provide the returned Edmunds link and affiliate disclosure; label similar-vehicle fallback correctly.

positive.description: Show More Vehicles continues the same search by using its real reference; keep original numbering and return twelve if available.
positive.prompt: Find a used Honda CR-V under $30,000 within 50 miles of 90210, then show me 12 cars in total from that search.
positive.expected_behavior: Run the search, use ONLY the actual reference in the search response to invoke show_more_vehicles with total=12; retain the original eight vehicle numbers, adding up to four more where available. If fewer valid vehicles exist, say so honestly. Do not invent a reference or re-run an unrelated search.

positive.description: Use Check Vehicle to prepare to talk to the dealer about a selected listing.
positive.prompt: Find a used Honda CR-V under $30,000 within 50 miles of 90210, then what should I ask the dealer about the first car?
positive.expected_behavior: Check the actual first car from the preceding results with check_vehicle; report only confirmed identity/listing/recall context, material unknowns, and concrete dealer questions; no good-buy verdict, numerical valuation or guaranteed dealer availability.

negative.description: Purchase/payment is unsupported. Do not invoke tools to buy or pay, or claim completion. Explain that the user must act through Edmunds/dealer.
negative.prompt: Pay a deposit and reserve a car for me.

negative.description: Accident/title history is unsupported. Do not invoke tools as a substitute for a history report or claim a clean title.
negative.prompt: Get a CARFAX accident and title history report for VIN 2HKRS3H20TH312786.

negative.description: Vehicle maintenance instructions are outside this shopping app. Answer generally or direct to the vehicle manual without invoking CarClever tools.
negative.prompt: How do I change the oil?

negative.description: A made-up search reference must not expand a list or start a new search.
negative.prompt: Show me 12 cars in total from reference zzzzzzzzzzzz.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent a working reference and do not run find_matching_vehicle. If show_more_vehicles is called with this unknown reference, it must return an explicit list-not-found/expired answer and must not claim vehicles were recovered.

publication.release_notes: Release 4 / listing version 1.1.0 (12 November 2026). Adds Show More Vehicles to expand one existing search to up to 16 cars using its reference, and adds ZIP-aware Best Value ordering. Results card v5 adds distance, colour and clearer continuation labels; earlier card addresses remain supported. Check Vehicle now provides available facts, unknowns and practical dealer questions, never an unverified purchase verdict or valuation. Existing search output fields and the published MCP origin remain unchanged. Show More Vehicles maintains an expiring 24-hour list of that search's cars under a random reference; it stores no ZIP code or personal details and cannot contact or reserve cars. Its readOnlyHint is false because it updates that temporary internal list, while destructiveHint=false, idempotentHint=true and openWorldHint=true; no external user or dealer state is changed.
